summary: Building a 4-page static HTML5/CSS/JS corporate website for 'Brainscribe', an India-based IT services company headquartered in Pune, established 2019. Blue and white corporate theme. Pages: Home, About Us, Services, Contact Us. Services include .NET/SharePoint/SQL Server development, Moodle LMS, Staffing, XDT, Azure/AWS hosting, and Instructional/Graphics Design for eLearning. Contact Us page will have a HubSpot form placeholder. Logo placeholder box in header. Images in /images folder. .env file for configurable settings. Delivered as a ZIP package.
architectural_notes: Static HTML5/CSS/JS site — no backend/database; Contact Us uses HubSpot form embed placeholder
All environment variables (email, reCAPTCHA, etc.) stored in .env file for easy configuration
Images stored in a dedicated /images folder for easy editing
Blue and white corporate color theme — no dark or bright colors
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Corporate hero banner with abstract blue geometric shapes and subtle grid lines, wide format (hero-banner.dim_1440x600.png)
- Abstract illustration representing Microsoft .NET and SharePoint development with code and blue tones (service-dotnet.dim_600x400.png)
- Abstract illustration representing Moodle LMS e-learning platform with book and graduation icons in blue (service-moodle.dim_600x400.png)
- Abstract illustration representing IT staffing and team management with people silhouettes in corporate blue (service-staffing.dim_600x400.png)
- Abstract illustration representing offshore extended development teams with global connectivity lines (service-xdt.dim_600x400.png)
- Abstract illustration representing cloud hosting on Azure and AWS with cloud and server icons in blue (service-cloud.dim_600x400.png)
- Abstract illustration representing instructional and graphic design for eLearning with design tool icons (service-design.dim_600x400.png)
- Corporate office or team illustration in blue and white tones for the About page (about-hero.dim_1200x500.png)

existing_features.title: Create a shared HTML header component (included on all 4 pages) with a placeholder box displaying the text 'Brainscribe' in place of a logo, a navigation menu linking to Home, About Us, Services, and Contact Us pages, and a blue & white corporate color scheme. The header must be responsive.
Create a shared HTML footer component (included on all 4 pages) with company name 'Brainscribe', headquarter location (Pune, India), copyright year, and quick navigation links.

Create the Home Page (index.html) with the following sections: (1) Hero section with the Brainscribe tagline 'Engineering Intelligence. Empowering Growth.' and a brief mission statement; (2) Services overview section with icon cards for each service (Custom .NET/SharePoint/SQL development, Moodle LMS, Staffing, XDT, Azure/AWS Hosting, Instructional & Graphics Design); (3) Stats bar displaying '6+ Years in Business' and '50+ Projects Delivered'; (4) A brief 'Why Choose Us' section with 3–4 value propositions; (5) A call-to-action section linking to the Contact Us page.

Create the About Us Page (about.html) with the following sections: (1) Company introduction with mission statement and founding story (established 2019, headquartered in Pune); (2) Vision & Values section with 3–4 core values represented as icon cards; (3) Milestones / timeline section highlighting key company history points since 2019; (4) A 'Why Brainscribe' differentiation section.

Create the Services Page (services.html) with a dedicated section for each of the following 6 service areas, each containing a heading, descriptive content, and a relevant icon or inline SVG infographic: (1) Custom Application Development in Microsoft Technologies (.NET, SharePoint, SQL Server); (2) Moodle LMS Development, Customization & Integration; (3) IT Staffing Services across all technologies; (4) Offshore Extended Development Teams (XDT); (5) Hosting & Infrastructure Management using Azure and AWS; (6) Instructional Design & Graphics Design Services for eLearning.

Create the Contact Us Page (contact.html) with: (1) A HubSpot form placeholder section — a clearly marked div with a comment like '<!-- INSERT HUBSPOT FORM EMBED CODE HERE -->' and a visible placeholder box in the UI indicating where the form will appear; (2) Company contact information showing Pune, India as the headquarter address; (3) A brief introductory paragraph above the form placeholder. Do NOT implement a custom HTML contact form on this page. The page should be styled consistently with the rest of the site.

Apply a consistent blue and white corporate visual theme across all pages. Use a professional sans-serif typography system, a primary blue palette (e.g., navy/corporate blue #003366 or similar), white backgrounds, subtle grey accents, and clean section layouts with generous whitespace. The design should feel like a modern enterprise IT services company website — trustworthy, clean, and content-rich. Avoid dark themes, neon colors, and overly decorative elements.

Create a dedicated /images folder structure under frontend/public/images with placeholder images for: (1) a hero banner image for the Home page (hero-banner.jpg or inline SVG fallback), (2) service section visuals for each of the 6 services, and (3) an About page visual. All image references in the pages must use relative paths pointing to this /images folder so that replacing files is straightforward.

new_feature_requests.summary: Home Page - corporate blue/white theme with tagline, mission, services overview, stats (6 years, 50+ projects)
About Us Page - company history (est. 2019), Pune HQ, mission statement, team/values sections
Services Page - dedicated sections for each service: .NET/SharePoint/SQL, Moodle LMS, Staffing, XDT, Azure/AWS Hosting, Instructional/Graphics Design
Contact Us Page - HubSpot form placeholder, Pune address, .env-configurable settings
Shared: logo placeholder box in header, /images folder structure, .env file for configurable variables, ZIP package output

Organize all image assets in a dedicated /images folder. Use relevant, high-quality placeholder images (via placeholder services or inline SVG illustrations) for hero banners, service section visuals, and about page visuals. Each image reference in HTML must use a relative path from the /images folder so that replacing image files is straightforward.

Create a .env file at the project root with configurable environment variable placeholders for: CONTACT_EMAIL (recipient email for form submissions), RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY, RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY, and SMTP_* credentials (host, port, username, password). Add a README.md explaining each variable and how to configure it. Note that the HubSpot form on Contact Us will eventually replace any direct email/form logic, but the .env is provided for future flexibility and completeness.
Package all files (index.html, about.html, services.html, contact.html, /css, /js, /images, .env, README.md) as a downloadable ZIP archive and provide it as the final output.

Create a .env file at the project root containing placeholder environment variables: CONTACT_EMAIL, RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY, RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, and SMTP_PASSWORD. Each variable should have a descriptive placeholder value (e.g., CONTACT_EMAIL=your@email.com) so recipients know what to fill in.

Create a README.md file at the project root that explains: (1) the project structure and page descriptions, (2) each .env variable — its purpose and how to configure it, (3) a note that the HubSpot form on the Contact Us page will eventually replace any direct email/form logic, and (4) instructions for local setup and how to replace placeholder images in the /images folder.
